build.searchTitleWhy: NO Vietnamese article represents a food bowl: "Bát", "Chén" and "Tô (định hướng)" are all disambiguation pages, "Bát (đồ dùng)" and "Tô (đồ dùng)" 404. The bare title "Tô" is a département in Burkina Faso. This word ships with its Fluent fallback ("Bowl with spoon") or a photograph his mother takes of their own bowl. Do not fetch it.
